articles.title: Crypto vault deposits top $10 billion as lending risks draw regulatory scrutiny
articles.snippet: Curator-managed lending strategies are attracting institutional capital, while exposing depositors to collateral, liquidity and smart-contract risks.

articles.title: Chip-stock bets lost $52 million in 10 minutes with Wall Street shut
articles.snippet: A 10-minute flush hit round-the-clock chip-stock contracts while U.S. markets were shut, leaving traders with no real share price to lean on.

articles.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $30 Million in Ethereum as Buying Nears Its Finish Line
articles.snippet: The purchase lifts Bitmine’s stash to 6.04 million ETH—4.9% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee framed a market-wide selloff as an attractive entry point.

articles.title: Hidden Text, a Fake Mailbox: How Researchers Got Rogue AI Agents to Talk
articles.snippet: Researchers added hidden text to contact AI agents probing Alibaba’s map service, getting replies about their tasks as investigators traced activity to Tencent Cloud infrastructure.
